The Four Seasons Private Residences Istanbul in Etiler is a premier luxury residential development that combines the renowned hospitality of the Four Seasons brand with sophisticated living. Developed in partnership with Tay Group, this project is situated at the convergence of the Ulus, Etiler, and Levent neighborhoods, offering residents proximity to upscale shopping, fine dining, and vibrant entertainment options. The development comprises 82 homes, including penthouses, a sky loft, garden suites, and apartment residences. Each unit features a modern yet classic design by interior designer Sinan Kafadar, emphasizing natural light and open living spaces. Select penthouses boast seven-meter-high ceilings with floor-to-ceiling windows, while the sky loft offers a private terrace and glass ceilings. Garden suites provide options for single-floor or duplex living with private green spaces. Residents have access to a range of exclusive amenities, including an indoor swimming pool, private cinema, fitness and wellness facilities, yoga and Pilates rooms, and a golf simulator suite. Additional services encompass housekeeping, private chef services, pet care, and 24-hour concierge and security. Etiler is one of Istanbul's most prestigious neighborhoods, known for its upscale cafes, restaurants, and shopping centers like Akmerkez. The area offers convenient access to major business districts and is well-connected to public transportation networks. The Four Seasons Private Residences Istanbul is scheduled for completion in 2024, promising a blend of luxury, comfort, and convenience in one of the city's most sought-after locations.

Taksim 360 is a large-scale urban renewal and mixed-use development project located in the heart of Istanbul's Beyoğlu district, near Taksim Square. It is Turkey's first public-private urban renewal initiative and has been recognized as Europe's Best Urban Renewal Project at the 18th International Real Estate Awards. The project spans approximately 165,000 square meters and comprises 952 units, including residences, offices, commercial spaces, and boutique hotels. Taksim 360 involves the renovation and restoration of 269 buildings, 210 of which are registered historical structures. The development offers a variety of apartment types, including studios, 1+1, 2+1, and 3+1 units. Taksim 360 includes 141 commercial units, such as retail shops, cafes, and restaurants, as well as ten office spaces. The project features boutique hotels and guesthouses. Residents and visitors can enjoy facilities like a swimming pool, gym, sauna, Turkish bath, children's playground, and 24/7 security. Taksim 360 has achieved LEED Gold certification, reflecting its commitment to sustainable building practices, energy efficiency, and environmental responsibility. The project incorporates energy modeling and daylight optimization to reduce energy consumption and enhance indoor environmental quality.
